lines.t: Like an apple tree among the trees or the woods
So is my beloved among the suns
I sat down in his shed with great delight
And his fruit was sweet to my taste
The voice of my beloved
Behold, he comes
Leaping upon the mountains
Skipping upon the hills
My beloved is mine and I am his
He is the chief among ten thousand
His left hand is under my head
And his right hand embraces me
Sustain me with cakes of raisins
Refresh me with apples
For I am lovesick
Tell me who you are, my love Where you feed your flock
Where you make it rest at noon By night on my bed
I sought the one I love I sought him
But I did not find him I will rise now
I said and go about the city In the streets and in the squares
I would seek the one I love, I sought him
But I did not find him
My beloved is mine and I am his
He is the chief among ten thousand
His left hand is under my head
And his right hand embraces me
Sustain me with cakes of raisins
Refresh me with apples
For I am lovesick
Set me as a seal upon your heart
As a seal upon your heart
For love is as strong as death
Jealousy as cruel as the grave
Its flashes are flashes of fire
A most vehement flame
Many waters cannot quench love, nor can the floods drown it.
My beloved is mine, and I am his.
Thanks for watching.
